group.name: RB3 Stage Kit
group.description: RB3 cue-mode strobes, rendered on a DMX light array from the live RB3E StageKit stream: the four Slow/Medium/Fast/Fastest white strobe rates driven by the game's beat clock. The always-active RB3 gameplay look is authored separately.

cues.name: Strobe Slow
cues.description: White strobe at a sixteenth-note rate.

cues.name: StageKit Mirror
cues.description: The always-active RB3 gameplay look: mirrors the StageKit LED banks onto the DMX rig, additively blending overlapping colours, folded to any rig size via the virtual 8-step ring.

notes.label: Notes
notes.title: StageKit mirror
notes.note: Re-renders the four RB3 LED bank masks (red/green/blue/yellow) onto the rig every cue-called keepalive. build-ring folds the rig to a virtual 8-step ring (4 lights -> LED i on light i&3, 8 -> 1:1, 16 -> interleaved), matching the direct StageKit processor.

notes.label: Notes
notes.title: Per-bank additive layers
notes.note: Each bank paints on its own low layer band (red 10+, green 20+, blue 30+, yellow 40+; +ring index) with blend 'add', so overlapping banks composite additively like the direct processor. An unlit cell paints 'transparent' (passes through). The set-colors are non-blocking with a 50ms hold so a layer>0 cell survives between ~30Hz keepalives.
